macros.name: iexec
macros.doc: The sole command supplied by this package is \iexec [⟨options⟩] {⟨cmd⟩}. Its only mandatory argument, ⟨cmd⟩, denotes the command to be executed through the terminal shell (bash, or whichever shell is configured as the default in the host console).
